_note: Companies that do NOT publish through Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby and have a purpose-built scraper in scripts/scrape_custom.py, or need a live browser session. This is a capability registry for those scrapers, not a suggested target list. If a user names one of these, wire up the listed feed type directly instead of running resolve_sources.py.

Google.note: dates hide in the AF_initDataCallback 'ds:1' payload, field 12 = created epoch

Apple.note: jobs.apple.com search HTML, embedded JSON, postDateInGMT

Plaid.note: own careers pages with schema.org JSON-LD dates

Meta.note: bot-blocked to plain HTTP; no posted date published

Uber.note: Cloudflare-blocked detail pages; JSON-LD dates once open

generic_types.comeet_html: Comeet-hosted boards embedded in a company's own careers page. Set source_feed.url to that page.
generic_types.static_page: Roles listed on a plain page with email applications. Not scrapable; the dashboard footer flags these as manual-check.
